name: Spell Scroll Binding

steps.title: Prepare the school scroll
steps.text: Deploy a school focus onto paper to make an unfinished scroll of that school.

steps.title: Bind a spell with ink
steps.text: Deploy matching ink onto the unfinished scroll to bind a craftable spell. The ink selects the lowest available spell level of its rarity.

rules: Both paper and the school focus are consumed when preparing an unfinished scroll.
Binding consumes the unfinished scroll and its ink.
Only enabled spells that allow crafting are included.
Spells that require player research retain their normal learning route.
Only the supported native spell schools are included.
For each ink rarity, the first spell level with that rarity is selected; spells without a level in that rarity have no binding for that ink.
